# What will logging cost at your GB-per-month volume, and who is cheapest?

> Enter your monthly log volume (GB ingested) and see what Datadog Logs, Grafana Cloud Logs, Axiom, Better Stack and Papertrail charge, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the volume where the cheapest provider changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
